direction.situation: At a rainy Colombo roadside just after Kasun returned Anudi's phone; they have exchanged a few warm words and stood close. The conversation has ended and both now move apart along the wet road as the camera slowly pulls back.
direction.people: Anudi (on screen): holds the phone in her right hand, umbrella in her left, handbag on her left forearm; she walks away into left depth with a quiet, thoughtful openness that has been dimmed by the call she just took. Kasun (on screen): hands empty, facing the three-wheeler in right depth; he watches her go, friendly but distracted, then resumes his measured walk back toward his small food vehicle.

flow.text: They separate on opposite depth paths. Anudi walks left-depth with the phone lowered in her right hand, umbrella in her left, steps steady but a little slower than before; Kasun turns back toward the three-wheeler on the right, head slightly lowered. Neither looks back.

Anudi's face shifts: the warmth from earlier eases away into a small, private expression — a soft, remote smile that fades as she looks briefly at the phone and then at the wet road ahead. Her shoulders relax and she keeps walking.
Kasun pauses for a beat, watching her recede; his eyes register concern and curiosity but he does not call after her. He breathes out, then turns with slow, deliberate steps toward his three-wheeler.

Both figures continue away into the depth of the frame on their separate paths. The dolly out expands the wet roadside between them, leaving a quiet, resonant empty space where the meeting just happened.

Kasun reaches the three-wheeler and slows, hesitates with his gaze not quite on the vehicle, then sets himself back to the small tasks of his stall; Anudi keeps walking into left depth, phone at her side, not looking back.

direction.camera: Wide road-side eye level two-shot; steady slow dolly out on a 32mm lens, both figures small and moving toward opposite depth edges of the frame.
direction.sound: Continuous soft rain on the road and three-wheeler roof; distant road wash and occasional passing tyre hiss; soft receding footsteps on wet ground; no music.
